answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 5 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the ripple. Promotion is logged in reef and signal recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and therefore a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 251 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
